source.title: Accelerated High-Accuracy Sampling from a Warm Start via the Proximal Bouncy Particle Sampler

source_hypotheses.formula: for all x,v, alpha||v||² <= D²V(x)[v,v] <= beta||v||²

objects.phase: E x E, source R^d x R^d; explicitly permitted finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel realization, including rank0.
objects.fixed_parameters: V,alpha,beta,eta and deterministic y,r,z0,n. n is a fixed finite event-depth index, not physical time or a random stopping index.
objects.actual_model: c=y-eta grad V(r); g_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r); literal source harmonic Phi, reflection S with R0=I, rate lambda=sqrt(eta)[p dot g_r(x)]+; Lambda_z(u)=integral_0^u lambda(Phi_s z)ds; tau_z(e)=inf{u>=0:Lambda_z(u)>=e}, empty inf=infinity.
objects.record_space: R=(NNReal x (E x E)) coproduct {stopped}; live(T,z) records cumulative finite event time and post-jump phase. stopped is absorbing and carries no fictitious phase/time.
objects.record_recursion: R0=live(0,z0). R_(k+1)=next(e_k,R_k); live finite wait u gives live(T+u,S(Phi_u z)), live infinite wait gives stopped; stopped remains stopped.
objects.probability: Omega=real sequences, P=product Exp1, eps(w)_k=toNNReal(w_k) is ambient null-set extension; source E_(n+1)=raw w_n. H_n(w)=(R_j(eps(w)))_(j in Fin(n+1)), mu_n=map H_n P.
objects.history: Hist_n=R^(Fin(n+1)); Hist_(n+1)=R^(Fin(n+2)). Complete actual old prefix is retained. Abstract histories are unrestricted Borel tuples, including impossible/inconsistent ones.
objects.next_relative_wait: W_n(w)=tau_z(eps(w)_n) for live R_n=(T,z), and0 for stopped. t_n=real finite projection untopD0 of W_n. Infinite/stopped extraction0 is auxiliary only.
objects.cutoff: Every fixed Borel d:Hist_n->NNReal, finite at each history and possibly unbounded across histories. d(H_n) is random by composition. d cannot inspect raw w_n or later inputs except through the past H_n.
objects.strict_guard: B_d={w:0<W_n(w)<d(H_n(w))} using extended nonnegative comparisons; includes only live positive finite next waits.
objects.density_input89: D_d(h,s)=1_(0<s<d(h))*rho(h_last,s), with rho(live(T,z),s)=lambda(Phi_s z)exp(-Lambda_z(s)) on positive s and rho(stopped,s)=0. nu_d=(mu_n product real Lebesgue).withDensity D_d. Actual89 derives map (H_n,t_n)(P restricted B_d)=nu_d and nu_d(univ)<=1.
objects.forced_append: For finite prospective u>=0, append_n(h,u) preserves every old entry j<=n, and its new entry is live(T+u,S(Phi_u z)) if h_n=live(T,z), stopped if h_n=stopped. Source forces this on positive finite live waits; any behavior at unsupported totalization arguments is an explicitly disclosed Borel convention.
objects.real_lift: For transport of the89 real-time measure, use a jointly Borel total A_n(h,s) agreeing with append_n(h,s) on live h_n and s>0. A canonical possible real extension is append_n(h,toNNReal(s)); another Borel out-of-support extension may be equivalent for nu_d. No prospective Lean/kernel API is declared source truth.
objects.joint_lift: J_n(h,s)=(A_n(h,s),s) in Hist_(n+1) x real; actual observation Z_(n+1)(w)=(H_(n+1)(w),t_n(w)).

target.attribution: Attributed ASTIS source-implicit completion of the finite recursion A.1/A.2 and one measurable history-extension step needed to iterate the A.7 factors. Not a printed standalone author theorem.
target.quantifiers: Same six standing analytic hypotheses, all deterministic y,r,z0,n, every fixed Borel d:Hist_n->NNReal, every Borel old-history event A, and all jointly Borel nonnegative extended tests F:Hist_(n+1) x real -> ENNReal.
internally_derived: Joint Borel A_n and J_n on every abstract history and real prospective time, by actual source Borel maps and finite-index/tag operations.
Measurability of the actual H_(n+1), t_n and strict restricted pair, without a constructor/measurability provider.
For every w in B_d, H_(n+1)(w)=A_n(H_n(w),t_n(w)), with old prefix equality at every index and the new record equality derived from literal Nat recursion and finite-wait branch.
map Z_(n+1)(P restricted B_d)=map J_n nu_d, and marginal map H_(n+1)(P restricted B_d)=map A_n nu_d.
The transported joint/marginal measures are finite subprobabilities by the89 mass bound and measurable pushforward; no normalization.
All-history measurable parameter-integral of F(A_n(h,s),s)D_d(h,s) and its unnormalized old-history-event identity.
target.formula: integral_(B_d intersect H_n^-1(A)) F(H_(n+1)(w),t_n(w)) P(dw) = integral_A [integral_real F(A_n(h,s),s) D_d(h,s) ds] mu_n(dh).
target.whole_history_law: This is the actual COMPLETE n+1 history tuple law restricted to the positive finite cutoff event. It is not the unrestricted probability law mu_(n+1): stop/infinite/outside-cutoff mass is not supplied by this finite component.
target.minimal_substantive_delta: New derived constructor measurability plus actual guarded recursion identity and actual H_(n+1) law. Rephrasing89 with an assumed append identity/measurability or only an artificial append map without actual n+1 equality would be a wrapper and fails this target.
target.tests: Joint F is fixed deterministic Borel with no tail/random-function argument; can be unbounded or infinity. Borel A may be null. Borel d/F/A are admissible measurable tests, not extra source analytic/independence/density hypotheses.
target.kernel_api: A deterministic Borel pushforward suffices. A mapped-kernel presentation is optional packaging and must internally identify the genuine measure branch; no kernel/provider binder or new conditional-law assumption is authorized.

boundary_conventions.stopped: If old last record is stopped, strict event B_d is false and D_d=0. Natural absorbing append appends stopped. This edge does not recover the positive stopped atom of the unrestricted next history law.
boundary_conventions.infinity: Live tau=infinity remains a no-finite-event possibility, and fails W<finite d; t_n=0 offguard is not a phase/time at infinity. Never flow or reflect at infinity.
boundary_conventions.zero: Wait0 excluded by strict guard. d(h)=0 gives zero finite measure. Positive source clocks imply wait0 is a null ambient issue, but no atom-null theorem is needed for this positive-guard transport.
boundary_conventions.n0: H0 is singleton initial record, H1 contains it and the actual first updated record; next raw coordinate is w0.
boundary_conventions.rank0: Rank0 allowed, zero hazard yields no positive finite event almost surely and zero strict density; transport is zero measure.
boundary_conventions.nullA: No division by mu_n(A), no positivity premise or conditional representative; restrictions and extended integrals remain unnormalized.
boundary_conventions.unrealizable: Borel append/pair lift and parameter integrand are defined on every abstract history. Actual recursion identity is only asserted for H_n(w) on the finite event, not arbitrary tuple realizability.
boundary_conventions.endpoints: Both actual and reference measure use strict0<s<d(h). Do not silently change < to <=. No no-atom/equal-endpoint-mass/exact strict mass assertion is needed for measurable pushforward of the already strict89 measure.
boundary_conventions.deterministic_depth: Random physical-time restarts or random event-depth n cannot replace fixed n. The random time t_n within the fixed-depth observation does not imply a strong Markov or unused-tail theorem at a random index.
boundary_conventions.totalization: The literal finite update at u>=0 is source-backed. Extension to all real s or other artificial inputs is a disclosed Borel convention; different choices agreeing on strict live support have identical transported finite measures. No totalization premise belongs in source assumptions.
boundary_conventions.density_mass: Mass<=1 is inherited for mapped measures, never a pointwise density<=1 assertion. After a noninjective append pushforward one should not claim Lebesgue density on the new history carrier without an additional reference/Jacobian argument.
boundary_conventions.consumer: For a fixed physical horizon T, d_T(h)=max(T-last_time,0) on live histories and0 on stopped is an admissible Borel cutoff; on strict support it gives T_n<T_(n+1)<T. The actual appended state/time becomes the next input of later factors. This is one finite transport step, not full ordered-time iteration or path construction.

route_in_at_most7steps: Retain actual fixed-reference source recursion/stopped record tags and complete H_n/H_(n+1), with fixed deterministic n and same positive input clocks.

Construct a full prefix-preserving finite append from actual Phi/S/time addition and derive its joint Borel property, including all-history/default cases, using A.2 maps or their exact verified realization.

For every actual w in the strict positive finite guard, unfold record(n+1), identify the finite wait extraction and prove equality of each old prefix coordinate and the new final record. Do not assume this identity.

Consume89 strict joint law of (H_n,t_n); compose with the Borel pair lift. On the restricted event the composition is exactly (H_(n+1),t_n), giving its actual pushforward law and the actual n+1 marginal.

Pull back old-history event A through the preserved prefix, and apply measurable nonnegative test integration/Tonelli for arbitrary joint F. Derive parameter measurability and retain null A/possibly infinite integrals.
Inherit total mass<=1 under pushforward. Keep finite-guard absence/stopping/infinite mass outside the result; no normalization or new history reference density.
Record the actual updated history as next input for future ordered-time iteration; leave density multiplication/coordinate change/final survival/path/count assembly and global results open.

potential_source_blockers.detail: Any assumed Measurable append, actual H_(n+1)=append(H_n,t_n), conditional density/kernel identity or arbitrary-history independence would replace the new ingredient with a premise.
Only proving an artificial append law, last-record law, or existing89 restatement without the literal actual full H_(n+1) identity does not meet the requested advance.
Unrestricted next-history probability, full A7, arbitrary random event depth or physical-time restart conclusions do not follow from this strict finite submeasure.
A prospective total negative-time or mapped-kernel constructor API cannot be a source premise. Its relevant support semantics and measurability must be derived.
Replacing strict cutoff by <=, renormalizing finite event mass, claiming exact strict mass or a new-history Lebesgue density requires a separate derived edge not in this target.
